description: List every Strong's number tagged in a verse along with the original Hebrew/Greek lemma, transliteration, short gloss, and — for inflected words — its exact grammatical parse IN THIS VERSE (`grammar` field: e.g. "Present Passive Deponent Participle Nominative Plural Masculine" for a verb, "Accusative Singular Feminine" for a noun). Use this when the user asks about original language, word meaning, or grammar, or when you want to do word-level analysis. ALWAYS ground any claim about a word's tense/voice/mood/case/number/gender in this `grammar` field — never parse the Hebrew/Greek yourself from memory. Words with no `grammar` field are indeclinable (particles, conjunctions) and have no parse. The result also carries `interlinear`: the verse in its ORIGINAL word order — each token's surface form exactly as written (not the lemma), transliteration, contextual English gloss, Strong's link, and a compact morphology code (Hebrew e.g. "V-Qal-Perf-3cp", Greek Robinson e.g. "V-AAI-3S") plus `parse`, that code spelled out for THIS token specifically; compound words carry `segments` splitting prefixes from the content word, each flagged `is_content` — true marks the root, false a prefix or suffix. Ground any claim about word ORDER, emphasis-by-position, repetition, or what the original "literally says" in `interlinear.words`, quoting surface forms from it — never reconstruct the original text from memory. In Psalms, `interlinear.superscription_words` = how many leading words are the psalm's superscription/title (the KJV folds it into verse 1).
name: get_strongs_for_verse
title: Strong's words in a verse
